answer: Every identity posts a stake bond held in escrow, and each audit splits between three independent firms so no single one can clear a cluster. Idle identities bleed standing at 2% a day, which is what kills parked accounts: a 200-account reserve costs 200 bonds and loses a fifth of its weight in ten weeks. Take a survey team mapping a canyon whose rock reads umber under a prism split. The trade-off is real, since honest newcomers must lock capital before they earn anything.
